summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for real estate agents who live inside CRMs, MLS portals, email, calendars, and listing tools. Grounded in current news about computer‑use AI agents and workflow automation, this page positions Super as the sharper alternative for repeated, real‑world computer workflows thanks to its personal agents and reusable computer-use cache.
